Diagonals

Source: R/numpy_array.R
jnp_diagonal.Rd

Ports of jnp.diagonal (diagonal of two axes, moved to the end), jnp.diag (extract a diagonal of a 2-D array or build a 2-D array from a 1-D diagonal), jnp.diagflat (2-D array with the flattened input on a diagonal), jnp.diag_indices, jnp.diag_indices_from (lists of index arrays for the main diagonal) and jnp.fill_diagonal.

Usage

jnp_diagonal(a, offset = 0L, axis1 = 0L, axis2 = 1L)

jnp_diag(v, k = 0L)

jnp_diagflat(v, k = 0L)

jnp_diag_indices(n, ndim = 2L)

jnp_diag_indices_from(arr)

jnp_fill_diagonal(a, val, wrap = FALSE, inplace = TRUE)

Arguments

a, v, arr

Array.

offset, k

0-based diagonal offset (positive above the main diagonal).

axis1, axis2

0-based axes.

n

Size of each dimension.

ndim

Number of dimensions.

val

Value(s) written on the diagonal (repeated as needed).

wrap

Not supported (must be FALSE).

inplace

Must be FALSE (arrays are immutable).

Value

An array, or a list of index arrays.
